description.content:
Create a new group in the challenge. The creator is auto-added as admin.
Requires: active participant, not already in a group for this challenge.
List all groups in the challenge with member counts.

Get the current user's group in this challenge, with full member list.
Returns null if the user is not in any group.

Get a group's detail with all members.
For private challenges, requires the user to be an active member.
Dissolve (delete) the group and all memberships. Group admin only.
Update group name and/or logo. Group admin only.

Invite a challenge participant to the group. Group admin only.
The invited user must be an active participant and not already in a group.

Leave the group. If the user is the last admin and no other admin exists,
the entire group is dissolved.

Remove a member from the group. Group admin only.
Cannot remove yourself: use the leave endpoint instead.

Request to join a group. The user must be an active challenge participant
and not already in a group. Group admin must approve.
Approve a join request. Group admin only.
Reject a join request. Group admin only.
